answer_summary: TypeBox is a TypeScript-first JSON Schema builder pinned at 0.33.17 in this project [1]. Fastify consumes its schemas natively for request validation [2].

references.title: TypeBox - JSON Schema in TypeScript

results.title: TypeBox - JSON Schema in TypeScript
results.snippet: TypeBox provides a fluent API for composing JSON Schema documents that double as TypeScript types via Static<T>.
